description.zh: 创建频道的时间戳，支持查询最近30天的数据。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。
description.en: The UNIX timestamp of channel creation. Supports querying data from the last 30 days, expressed as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

description.zh:
释放频道的时间戳，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。参数为空表示获取当前时间。
> 如果传入的频道释放时间超过真实的释放时间，将返回从创建时间开始到真实释放时间之间的数据。
description.en:
The UNIX timestamp indicating when the channel was released, in seconds. If this parameter is empty, data up to the current time will be retrieved.  
> If the provided channel release time exceeds the actual release time, the system returns data from the Creation Time to the actual release time.

title.zh: 获取频道内发布端的用户列表
title.en: Obtain the list of publishing users in the channel

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于获取频道内发布端的用户列表（按用户在线时长降序）。例如：在用户列表中您可以查询用户加入通话时间、通信时长等信息。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### How-To  
This API is used to retrieve the list of publishing users in a channel, sorted in descending order by their online duration. For example, in the User List, you can query information such as the time when a user joined the call and the communication duration.  
### queries per second (QPS) Limit  
The QPS limit for this API is 10 queries per second per User. If the limit is exceeded, Rate Limiting will be applied to the API Call, which may Impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately.
